title: Jesus Lover of My Soul
lyrics_original: Jesus, Lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the raging waters roll,
While the tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Savior,
Hide, till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide;
O receive my soul at last.
Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee
Leave, ah! leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring
Cover my defenseless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.
Thou, O Christ, art all I want,
All in all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind!
Just and holy is Thy Name,
I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am;
Thou art full of truth and grace.
Plenteous grace with Thee is found,
Grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound;
Make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the Fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart;
Rise to all eternity.

bible_verses.english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, firm and steadfast, and entering into that which is within the veil;
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

devotional.prayer_english: Jesus, Lover of my soul, I turn to You today as my only true refuge. When the winds of life howl around me, help me to draw near and hide beneath the shadow of Your wings. I place my helpless heart into Your faithful hands, trusting You to guide me safely through every storm. Hold me close, Lord, and fill me with Your peace. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life's tempests often leave us feeling vulnerable and overwhelmed, but Charles Wesley's tender hymn reminds us where true safety lies. When the raging waters roll, we do not have to fight the waves in our own strength. Jesus opens His arms to be our sanctuary, holding us close until the storm passes. Today, let go of self-reliance and rest deeply in the unwavering love of the Savior who anchors your soul.
